blocks.text: Myanmar human rights activist and ex-political prisoner Bo Kyi received the Magsaysay award on Sunday, calling for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations to help restore democracy in Myanmar and secure the release of political prisoners. Speaking at the award ceremony in Manila, Bo Kyi voiced concerns about the situation of more than 15,000 political prisoners in Myanmar who remain behind bars as well as the people who have been suffering since the 2021 military coup.
